description.value: Ruth & Dean is a cozy neighbourhood café and bakery in Oak Bay, Victoria, serving housemade pastries, brunch, and lunch in a welcoming, community-focused atmosphere. Founded in 2015, it is known for its rotating daily cakes, Monogram Coffee, and comfort-food menu built on locally sourced ingredients. Touring cyclists will find a satisfying stop for a full brunch or a pastry and coffee, with both dine-in and takeout available.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 7m; rack at 11m; rack at 47m; rack at 47m; rack at 84m. Total: 2 spaces.
